, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified the song tied to the February 17, 2017 country radio add as “Seein’ Red” (which was added July 11, 2016) instead of “Small Town Boy.” This wrong assumption sent the search down the wrong path and led to pursuing an incorrect album release window (around Feb 24, 2017) instead of confirming that the album Current Mood was released on September 8, 2017.
